title: Résumé builder
sub: No résumé yet? Answer a few questions — we'll build a clean, ATS-safe one.
nameRequired: Just your name to get going.

contact.title: Who are you?
contact.name: Full name
contact.headline: Headline — the job title you're going for
contact.optionalHint: Only the name is required — everything else can wait.

experience.title: Work experience
experience.empty: No work experience yet? Skip — projects and service count too.
experience.bullets: What did you do? One line each.
experience.bulletsHint: Start with a verb; numbers help — e.g. "Cut build time 40%".

projects.title: Projects
projects.hint: Side or school projects count as experience.
projects.name: Project name

service.title: Military service
service.hint: Standard on Israeli résumés — and it's real experience. Not relevant? Skip.
service.bullets: What did you do? One line each.

education.title: Education
education.hint: Degrees, bootcamps and courses all belong here.

skills.title: Skills
skills.hint: Press Enter or comma to add each one.

finish.title: Finish up
finish.summaryHint: 2–3 sentences about who you are. Leaving it empty is fine.
finish.honesty: Every word here is yours — we never invent facts.
finish.replaceWarn: Saving replaces your current saved résumé ({{label}}).
finish.savedToast: Saved — it now powers Jobs, Tailor and Tools.
finish.saveError: Could not save. Is the backend running?
finish.atsNote: Single-column, ATS-safe — no tables, columns or images.
